fragments.label: A summer that may not have happened
opening: The afternoon had been left open on the kitchen counter.
Someone had turned July all the way up.
sensory: The screen door clicked in the heat
A sprinkler counted backward across the lawn
Peaches cooled in a blue bowl
witnesses: a neighbor whose name has been misplaced
the dog from two houses over
endings: The light stayed there after everyone left.

fragments.label: The hallway after everyone went home
opening: The building became enormous after six o'clock.
Every office door had learned to whisper.
sensory: The carpet held the day's last footsteps
One fluorescent light kept changing its mind
A copier warmed the empty air
witnesses: the person who always left last
endings: The elevator arrived without being called.
You took the long way out on purpose.

fragments.label: Rain observed from a borrowed room
opening: The room was not yours, but the weather behaved as if it was.
Rain made a temporary address on the glass.
sensory: A radiator ticked beside the window
Wet traffic turned into ribbons below
The curtains smelled faintly of dust
witnesses: someone asleep in the next room
a lamp with a crooked shade
the city pretending not to listen
endings: By morning, the room had forgotten you.
You left the window exactly as you found it.

fragments.label: A birthday with one detail missing
opening: Everyone agreed the candles were the important part.
The photograph begins just after somebody laughed.
sensory: Paper hats leaned toward the cake
Frosting marked the edge of a sleeve
witnesses: a cousin who may have been a friend
endings: The missing detail is still making a wish.
Nobody can agree what song came next.

fragments.label: The drive home from somewhere unnamed
opening: The road knew where you were going before you did.
The car was full of a conversation already over.
sensory: Dashboard light pooled in your lap
Telephone poles passed in patient intervals
A paper cup rolled under the seat
witnesses: the moon in the passenger window
endings: Home appeared before you were ready.
You sat in the driveway through the end of the song.

fragments.label: The first snow in a place without winter
opening: At 3:14, the air began inventing snow.
The forecast denied everything while the rooftops turned white.
sensory: Cold gathered on the inside of the windows
Tiny footprints ended at the mailbox
witnesses: a weather reporter with no explanation
the orange tree under a borrowed coat
endings: It melted before anyone could prove it.
For years, the town kept the next morning free.
